name: BLUCK: A Benchmark Dataset for Bengali Linguistic Understanding and Cultural Knowledge
description: BLUCK is a comprehensive benchmark dataset designed to evaluate language models on Bengali linguistic understanding, cultural knowledge, history, phonetics, and semantics. Developed by researchers at KAIST and published at BLP-2025, it comprises 2,366 multiple-choice questions across 23 subcategories that capture regional cultural heritage and linguistic nuances.
